snippet.title: New Horror game Teaser - DREADCORE : Locked Unit
snippet.description:
GAME ON STEAM : DREADCORE : Locked Unit
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459030/DREADCORE__Locked_Unit/

Discord : https://discord.com/invite/mVPAAHXDy6

Enter the darkness, uncover the forgotten, and face what should never have been left behind. Locked Unit, the first addition to the Dreadcore cyberpunk horror anthology, invites players into a tense, mind-bending thriller where technology, identity, and horror collide.
A Routine Job… That Should Have Stayed That Way
In the heart of the Middle Sectors, where the past lingers like static interference, a routine maintenance request leads players into the abandoned basement of a decaying apartment complex. Reports of unexplained power fluctuations and signal interference have surfaced, all originating from a single, long-sealed storage unit.
Behind its rusted door lies something no one was meant to find—a failed experiment, a digital ghost, a presence that refuses to be forgotten. As the player unlocks the unit, they’ll uncover a makeshift lab, corrupted data logs, and a consciousness trapped between life and oblivion. But some doors were never meant to be opened—and what waits inside won’t let go so easily.
